example_sentences_in_bangla: এই সিদ্ধান্ত ধ্রুব, পরিবর্তন হবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: His belief is as firm as Dhruva.
This decision is set in stone, unchangeable.
history: Derived from the mythological story of Dhruva, a young devotee of Vishnu in the Bhagavata Purana, who attained the position of the pole star due to his unwavering devotion.
note: Refers to the pole star's fixed position in the sky, symbolizing permanence.
